name: complihub360-motion
description: Motion- und Video-Produktionssystem für CompliHub360: Reels, Marketing, Erklärvideos. Basiert auf claude-motion (MIT).

scripts.mux: ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/effort-silent.mp4 -i public/sfx.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -movflags +faststart -shortest out/effort.mp4
scripts.build: npm run sfx && npm run render && npm run mux
scripts.reel:build: npm run reel:sfx && remotion render ReelTemplate out/reel-template-silent.mp4 && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/reel-template-silent.mp4 -i public/reel-template.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -movflags +faststart -shortest out/reel-template.mp4 && node scripts/wave.mjs out/reel-template.mp4 --timeline videos/reel-template/timeline.json && python3 scripts/glitch-check.py out/reel-template.mp4
scripts.reel01:draft: remotion render Reel01-DE out/reel01-de-draft.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=26 && remotion render Reel01-EN out/reel01-en-draft.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=26
scripts.reel01:build: npm run reel01:sfx && remotion render Reel01-DE out/reel01-de-silent.mp4 && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/reel01-de-silent.mp4 -i public/reel-01.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -movflags +faststart -shortest out/reel01-de.mp4 && python3 scripts/glitch-check.py out/reel01-de.mp4 && node scripts/wave.mjs out/reel01-de.mp4 --timeline videos/reel-01/timeline.json && remotion render Reel01-EN out/reel01-en-silent.mp4 && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/reel01-en-silent.mp4 -i public/reel-01.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -movflags +faststart -shortest out/reel01-en.mp4 && python3 scripts/glitch-check.py out/reel01-en.mp4 && node scripts/wave.mjs out/reel01-en.mp4 --timeline videos/reel-01/timeline.json
scripts.styles:objects: node sims/build.mjs objects && node sims/capture.mjs objects --size 1080x1920 --dpr 1 --fps 30 --crf 16 --out public/styles/objects.mp4
scripts.styles:sfx: for s in line objects; do STYLE=$s python3 -m sfx sfx/cues/style_probes.py; done
